title: HAZBRA: processing code of a climate hazard dataset for Brazil
description: Code that computes the HAZBRA climate-hazard indicators for Brazil (rainfall, drought, heat and compound hazards) from CHIRPS, MERGE and BR-DWGD observations and the 19-model CLIMBRA CMIP6 ensemble at global warming levels of 1.5, 2 and 3 °C: GEV return levels, return-period shifts, ensemble statistics and model agreement, delta-change projections and municipal aggregation. The dataset itself is published separately (CC BY 4.0).
